retained_qualifications: H1 is inconclusive, H2 fails the overall criterion and H3 is inconclusive; the positive selected comparison is not support for those full hypotheses.
The three-model selected comparison uses 12 independent seeds per size; Goryachev remains visible in the full overview and is forced/undercovered at this input.
Late-quarter Wave-pinning/Holmes persistence ratios are bounded, not finite point estimates; unbounded bootstrap upper endpoints must remain visible.

The persistence direction and native majority-regime labels pass selected A7 checks; short-lag mobility itself is cadence-sensitive in some selected conditions and is not promoted as a robust headline.
Primary optical counts are imaging proxies at threshold0.5, fixed physical smoothing1.5/0.15 and cadence80/8 in native units; native regime fractions remain distinct.
Heading persistence and local activity regions are simulated polarity observables, not measured migration persistence or a cell-velocity law.
Geometric qualifications and literal single-region site MSD remain in S4/S5; the global-heading-derived physical-mobility proxy is not one tracked site diffusivity.
Historical Spring sampled-duration/cadence failures, finite-window bounds, coverage exclusions and E4 source-recovery/original-cohort distinctions remain explicit.
